name: Lidexa
indications_original: Lidexa™ is indicated for topical analgesia as directed by a healthcare provider.
contraindications_original:
For topical use only.
                     
Apply to the affected area 3 to 4 times daily or as directed by a healthcare provider.
warningsAndPrecautions_original:
Lidexa™ (Lidocaine Hydrochloride 38.8 mg/g) is supplied as a white topical cream in a 3 oz (85 g) tube.
                     
NDC 85477-330-07
adverseReactions_original: Lidexa™ is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to lidocaine or any component of the formulation.
